categories.title: Component Categories
categories.subtitle: Manage and organize items by category.
categories.help_p1: Categories are used to organize and group components based on their type or function.
categories.help_p2: They help you quickly filter and locate components, but do not affect quantities or stock calculations.
categories.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete category {name}?
delete_success: Category "{name}" was successfully deleted. Related components are now uncategorized.
delete_error: An error occurred while deleting the category.
